subject: Color specific tips containing certain letters/words

messages.author: b5040293c686adc0
messages.subject: Color specific tips containing certain letters/words
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,

I would like to color tips that contain a certain string of letters ("BEP." in my case). I have a phylogeny with 210 tips and about 40+ have the letter string "BEP." in the tip names. Is there a way to do this? The phylogeny file is attached. Thanks.

Guanyang

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: Color specific tips containing certain letters/words
parts: ggtree(x) + geom_tiplab(aes(color=grepl("BEP", label)))
On Sat, Dec 17, 2016 at 5:43 AM, Guanyang Zhang <gyz...@gmail.com> wrote:

I would like to color tips that contain a certain string of letters ("BEP." in my case). I have a phylogeny with 210 tips and about 40+ have the letter string "BEP." in the tip names. Is there a way to do this? The phylogeny file is attached. Thanks.

Guanyang

messages.author: 52b9f186ad2f5f59
messages.subject: Re: Color specific tips containing certain letters/words
parts:
Thank you for the reply. I'm not sure how I missed that in the manual. However, I was not able to make ggtext work for my circular tree where the labels need to be rotated. I'm sure I'm missing something. 

However, I did find an answer to my original question and it is very simple, based on Guangchuang's answer above and the topic that was just posted about labeling specific tip points. 

geom_tiplab2(aes(subset=grepl("Aa", label)), color="#999999") #All tip labels with "Aa" in them will be colored #999999 and the label is kept as text.  

Thank you all!

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Color specific tips containing certain letters/words
parts:
I thought you would like to color the tips in a way like this: Aa(in red)_Bb(in blue).

If you want to color tips in the way - if tips contain Aa, color in red, and color tips that contain Bb in blue, I think a better solution is to derive a variable (e.g., type) that contains Aa and Bb based on the tip labels. Then you can use geom_tiplab(aes(color = type)) to color the tips.

Thank you for the reply. I'm not sure how I missed that in the manual. However, I was not able to make ggtext work for my circular tree where the labels need to be rotated. I'm sure I'm missing something.
